# Your evolving project record

Keep one individual record with portfolio and RAG sections, and one shared group record. Add short updates and links rather than another weekly report. Keep private career reflection and personal information out of the public repository.

## Research and baseline

- Individual portfolio: original employer postings/date checked, responsibilities/eligibility, two career directions, chosen reader, existing evidence, gap and dated action. Link the private reflection where appropriate.
- Individual RAG: explain vector/graph/RAG, chunking/embeddings/entities, source permission, a sample representation and useful questions.
- Group: selected course problem, reader, source manifest and source-to-output process.
- Current Studio result, source/revision, actual checks, help received and next gap.

## Plan

- Two bounded approaches, comparison and chosen direction.
- Portfolio: role-to-evidence map, content outline and two lightweight layouts.
- RAG: chosen database/model architecture, import, representation, retrieval, generation, citations, hosting and limits.
- Group: source/transform/retrieve/review/output workflow and why vector, graph or both fits.
- Three to five observable stories/checks and a small evaluation set.
- Group owner/reviewer assignments covering design, implementation and checking.

## Build

- Current hosted site/demo, repository and chosen revision.
- Real import record, chunks or graph entities/relationships, retrieval trace and actual answers/output.
- Expected versus observed checks; local/CI/hosted results labeled accurately.
- Contribution/issue/PR links; mocks, unfinished behavior and next action.

## Checked release

- Repeatable setup/configuration, version, persistent storage and source references.
- Query evaluation, missing-evidence behavior, repeat import and permission checks.
- Hosting/resource/cost limits, private credentials and recovery instructions.

## Improve and demonstrate

- Real peer/date/task, actual observation and issue.
- Response, meaningful change, retest and remaining limit.
- Portfolio case studies showing the individual work and your group contribution.
- Final site/record/repository links, actual contribution and one decision each person can explain.

Submit the same links in the matching Canvas review with a short changed/checked/next note. AI roleplay does not count as a real human peer review. [Dates and rubric](/course/milestones).
